versions.changelog: No changes detected in this release. Version number updated only.

Initial release of API Endpoint Tester.

- CLI tool to test REST API endpoints using GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH methods.
- Supports custom headers and request bodies (JSON or form data).
- Validates HTTP status codes and response formats.
- Provides response details including status, headers, body, and response time.
- Requires Python 3 and the requests library.
